tips.title: Good Health Profile
tips.text: Your health profile looks good! Maintain your current lifestyle for optimal insurance rates.

reasons.detail: Non-smoking status significantly reduces your insurance premium.
BMI of 25.5 is slightly above normal (25-30). Minor impact on costs.
Age 30 qualifies for lower age-based premiums.
2 dependent(s) add a small amount to the base premium.

explanation.summary: Your profile looks healthy! You may qualify for lower premium rates.

recommendation.reason: Low risk profile. Basic coverage with essential benefits is sufficient.
